Cotton poplin blouse in cream #fdfbf7, relaxed collar, hip length, smooth cotton weave.
Tailored trousers in navy blue #1b2952, straight leg, ankle length, heavy twill fabric.
Leather ankle boots in black #0d0d0d, block heel, mid-calf shaft, genuine leather upper.
